parameters.help_en: The name of the migration task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination Alibaba Cloud region to which you want to migrate the source.

For example, if you want to migrate a source server to the China (Hangzhou) region, set RegionId to `cn-hangzhou`. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
迁移源需迁入的目标阿里云地域ID。

例如，您需要迁移源服务器至杭州，则RegionId为`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The main status of the migration task. Valid values:

- Ready: The task is not started.

- Running: The task is running.

- Stopped: The task is paused.

- InError: An error occurred.

- Finished: The task is complete.

- Waiting: The task is waiting.

- Expired: The task has expired.

- Deleting: The task is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务的主状态。取值范围：

- Ready：未开始。
- Running：运行中。
- Stopped：已暂停。
- InError：出错。
- Finished：已完成。
- Waiting：等待中。
- Expired：已过期。
- Deleting：删除中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The business status of the migration task. Valid values:

- Preparing: The task is being prepared.

- Syncing: Data is being synchronized.

- Processing: The task is being processed.

- Cleaning: The task is being cleared
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务的业务状态。取值范围：

- Preparing：准备中。
- Syncing：同步中。
- Processing：处理中。
- Cleaning：清理中
parameters.name: business_status

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the migration task list. The value starts from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中，迁移任务列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the migration sources. You can specify up to 50 migration source IDs
parameters.help_zh: 迁移源ID列表。N的最大值为50
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the migration tasks. You can specify up to 50 migration task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务ID列表。N的最大值：50
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the migration task. Valid values:

- 0: server migration.

- 1: operating system migration.

- 2: cross-zone migration.

- 3: agentless VMware migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务的类型。取值范围：

- 0：服务器迁移。
- 1：操作系统迁移。
- 2：跨可用区迁移。
- 3：VMware无代理迁移
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The key of tag N that is specified for the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

This parameter can be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http://或者https://
